amazon.scope: US Associates store bingmada-20, All tracking IDs; last updated Oct18 18:43 PDT. Tracking-ID table suppresses low-volume rows into Other, so no reliable seven-site order split.
amazon.limits: 71.43% is ordered items divided by clicks, not unique-buyer conversion or recommendation-product conversion. Direct ordered items are zero. Tiny sample and hidden tracking-ID detail prevent estimating each site's EPC or blaming old products for all lost search traffic. Costume uses authorized CJ, not Amazon.

merchantSample.method: Signed-in Amazon clean /dp/ URLs without affiliate tags, US delivery location New York 10001. No cart, checkout, SiteStripe-link creation, affiliate-link clicks or product-record edits. Delivery filter restored to China afterward.
